query: CTD local interaction extract; PMID 24548679; Permethrin CYP2C19
AuditNote: CTD direction is increases metabolism, meaning metabolic enzyme/substrate relationship; this is not evidence of enzyme induction or inhibition. CTD XLSX local extract did not contain Permethrin; experiment/ctd.csv contains the PMID 24548679 CTD row.
pubmed_verified_summary: PBOH and 3,4 PBOH were the only metabolites detected; experiments with recombinant CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 implicated CYP-catalyzed stereoselective permethrin cleavage followed by 4-hydroxylation to 3,4' PBOH.
pubmed_verified_quote: Coincubation with the CYP inhibitor ketoconazole and time course experiments with liver microsomes and recombinant CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 indicated CYP-catalyzed stereoselective cleavage of the ester followed by 4-hydroxylation to 3,4' PBOH.
abstract_result_sentence: Coincubation with the CYP inhibitor ketoconazole and time course experiments with liver microsomes and recombinant CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 indicated CYP-catalyzed stereoselective cleavage of the ester followed by 4-hydroxylation to 3,4' PBOH.
